concept.name: Forest Paper
concept.narrative: Quiet paper surfaces with a deep forest accent: a calm notebook you carry outdoors, matching 'Calm by default'.

references.name: frontend-design
references.how_used: Used the plan → review-against-brief process and its list of AI-default looks to reject cream+terracotta and SaaS card kits.

references.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines
references.how_used: Dynamic Type styles, dark mode palette, in-app purchase paywall clarity and restore button.

avoided_cliches: identical rounded cards with grey shadows
signature_elements: deep forest accent used only for the primary action
paper-like flat surfaces with hairline separators
anti_generic.rationale: The subject is calm outdoor thinking; colour comes from forest and paper, not from a UI kit.
